title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
title_zh: UNITAS：一种用于具身操控的三维原生世界动作模型

paragraphs.en: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents. Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, while images are view-dependent projections whose pixel distances do not directly encode physical distances. We introduce Unitas , to our knowledge the first 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric 3D frame within each interaction, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands. Action flow represents human hands and robot grippers as 3D point trajectories, while scene flow describes scene-point displacements conditioned on these trajectories. World-aligned 3D positional embeddings ground visual tokens with or without depth input, and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer encodes each point trajectory as one token anchored at its current 3D position. This interface supports both direct action execution and action-conditioned scene prediction. With 1.7B parameters, Unitas achieves the best action-conditioned scene prediction on RoboTwin among the compared methods, with up to 49% lower displacement errors than PointWorld, and state-of-the-art manipulation success, including 99.8% on LIBERO and an average of 85% across real-world tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS .
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）旨在回答一个相互关联的物理问题：给定任务指令，机器人应执行何种动作，以及该动作将如何改变周围的世界？ 大多数现有的 WAMs 都基于预训练的视频生成模型，并通过图像或视觉潜在变量来表示世界的演化过程。 然而，机器人的交互发生在具有度量意义的三维空间中，而图像则是依赖于视角的投影，其像素距离并不直接编码物理距离。 我们提出了 Unitas——据我们所知，这是首个原生支持三维的世界动作模型。它在每次交互中，通过一种通用的表示方式将观察、动作和场景动态统一到一个共享的度量三维框架内，且该表示方式适用于不同形态的机器人和人类双手。 动作流将人类双手和机器人抓取器表示为三维点轨迹，而场景流则描述了在这些轨迹条件约束下场景点的位移。 与世界对齐的三维位置嵌入能够为视觉标记提供物理基准（无论是否输入深度信息），而物理时间轨迹分词器则将每个点轨迹编码为一个以当前三维位置为锚点的标记。 这种接口既支持直接执行动作，也支持基于动作的场景预测。 Unitas 拥有 17 亿个参数，在 RoboTwin 数据集上实现了动作条件场景预测的最佳效果，与 PointWorld 相比，其位移误差最多降低了 49%，并在操作任务成功率方面达到了当前最优水平，包括 LIBERO 数据集上的 99.8% 成功率以及真实世界任务中的平均 85% 成功率。 代码可在 https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS 获取。

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs couple action learning with prediction of future images or visual latents, increasingly building on pretrained video models ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Cen et al., 2025 ; Bi et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) . Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, and an image is only a view-dependent projection of that space.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）旨在回答一个相互关联的物理问题：给定一项任务指令，机器人应执行何种动作，以及该动作将如何改变周围的世界？ 大多数现有的 WAMs 将动作学习与未来图像或视觉潜变量的预测相结合，并越来越多地基于预训练的视频模型（Yang et al., 2023；Li et al., 2025b；Zhu et al., 2025；Cen et al., 2025；Bi et al., 2025；Ye et al., 2026；Yuan et al., 2026b；Zhou et al., 2026b）。 然而，机器人交互发生在具有度量意义的三维空间中，而图像仅仅是该空间的一个依赖于视角的投影。

paragraphs.en: The same robot motion, object displacement, or contact event can produce different pixel changes across views, and equal pixel displacements need not correspond to equal physical distances ( Ze et al., 2024 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) . Differences in camera intrinsics and camera-to-robot poses further make this mapping vary across embodiments. Evaluations of video-based WAMs report sensitivity to viewpoint and robot-state changes ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and a photorealistic prediction may still misrepresent object displacement, deform rigid geometry, or allow static regions to drift ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Such visual representations leave metric motion and contact relationships implicit for spatial reasoning, prediction, and control.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的机器人运动、物体位移或接触事件在不同视角下可能产生不同的像素变化，而相等的像素位移并不一定对应相等的物理距离（Ze et al., 2024；Qu et al., 2025）。 相机内参和相机与机器人姿态的差异进一步导致这种映射关系在不同具体实现中存在差异。 基于视频的王冠装配模块（WAM）评估表明，其结果对视角和机器人状态的变化较为敏感（Zhang et al., 2026b），而且即使具有照片级真实感的预测也可能错误表示物体位移、使刚性几何结构发生形变，或导致静态区域出现漂移（Huang et al., 2026）。 这类视觉表示在空间推理、预测和控制中，将度量运动与接触关系以隐式方式呈现。

paragraphs.en: Recent methods incorporate depth, optical flow, scene flow, or reconstructed 4D geometry into prediction ( Zhen et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) or ground action generation in explicit 3D structure ( Shridhar et al., 2023 ; Ze et al., 2024 ; Zhen et al., 2024 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) . Yet geometry often serves as an input cue or auxiliary prediction target, rather than a shared interface for action generation and scene dynamics. PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) directly predicts metric point flows conditioned on externally supplied robot motion, rather than generating that motion from a task instruction. A 3D-native WAM should place observations, actions, and resulting scene changes in a shared metric frame, enabling task-conditioned behavior, consequence prediction, and executable control.
paragraphs.zh: 近期方法将深度、光流、场景流或重建的 4D 几何结构整合到预测（Zhen et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2026; Zhao et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026b）或基于显式 3D 结构的动作生成中（Shridhar et al., 2023; Ze et al., 2024; Zhen et al., 2024; Qu et al., 2025）。 然而，几何结构通常仅作为输入线索或辅助预测目标，而非动作生成与场景动态之间的共享接口。 PointWorld（Huang et al., 2026）直接预测基于外部提供的机器人运动的度量点流，而非从任务指令中生成该运动。 一种原生支持 3D 的 WAM 应将观察结果、动作及由此产生的场景变化置于共享的度量框架中，从而实现以任务为条件的行为、后果预测与可执行控制。

paragraphs.en: Realizing this 3D-native world action model presents three challenges. First, visual observations must be grounded in metric space even when depth is unavailable. We propose world-aligned 3D position embeddings derived from observed depth or learned weights over candidate positions along calibrated camera rays. Second, human hands and robot grippers have different morphologies and control interfaces. We propose action flow , which represents their motion as trajectories of corresponding 3D points in the shared frame. Third, trajectories differ in frame rate and duration across data sources. Representing each timestep as a token allocates backbone capacity across unequal physical-time intervals. We propose a physical-time trajectory tokenizer , which aligns each trajectory to elapsed time and encodes the whole trajectory as one token before the backbone. Scene flow describes scene-point displacements decoded from trajectory tokens conditioned on action flow.
paragraphs.zh: 认识到这种原生于三维世界的动作模型存在三个挑战。 首先，即使没有深度信息，视觉观察结果也必须基于度量空间。 我们提出与世界对齐的三维位置嵌入，这些嵌入由观测到的深度或沿校准相机光线的候选位置上的学习权重推导而来。 其次，人类手部和机器人夹具具有不同的形态和控制接口。 我们提出动作流，它将它们的运动表示为共享坐标系中相应三维点的轨迹。 第三，不同数据源中的轨迹在帧率和持续时间上存在差异。 将每个时间步表示为一个标记，会将骨干网络的能力分配给不等长的物理时间间隔。 我们提出一种物理时间轨迹分词器，它将每条轨迹与经过的时间对齐，并在输入骨干网络前将整个轨迹编码为一个标记。 场景流描述了从动作流条件化的轨迹标记中解码出的场景点位移。

paragraphs.en: In the backbone, observation tokens are grounded in world coordinates, while action-flow tokens across embodiments and scene-flow tokens are anchored at each point’s current 3D position, allowing the network to model motion through features associated with fixed spatial anchors. Given the instruction and current observations, a layer-coupled Mixture-of-Transformers jointly models point trajectories and executable commands. This supports two modes: policy mode directly generates executable actions, while simulator mode predicts scene changes conditioned on externally supplied action flow. A causal attention mask enables key–value caching of shared context across denoising steps, reducing repeated computation and accelerating inference.
paragraphs.zh: 在主干网络中，观察标记以世界坐标为基础，而跨实体体现的流动作标记和场景流标记则锚定在每个点的当前三维位置，使网络能够通过与固定空间锚点相关的特征来模拟运动。 根据指令和当前观察结果，一个层耦合的Transformer混合模型会联合建模点轨迹和可执行命令。 这支持两种模式：策略模式直接生成可执行动作，而模拟器模式则基于外部提供的流动作预测场景变化。 因果注意力掩码实现了跨降噪步骤共享上下文的键值缓存，从而减少了重复计算并加速了推理过程。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Unitas on action-conditioned scene prediction and robotic manipulation. In simulator mode, it leads the compared methods across all four RoboTwin scene-prediction metrics, reducing Moving ADE, Moving FDE, and Static ADE by 35%, 21%, and 49%, respectively, relative to PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . In policy mode, it achieves 99.8% success on LIBERO and outperforms larger video-based WAMs on RoboTwin. It leads the compared methods in VLABench success rate and progress score, and reaches 89.1% success on LIBERO-Plus with strong robustness to camera and robot-state changes. Real-robot success reaches 90% on Organize Books and 65% on Pack the Ball , exceeding both baselines. Ablations show that world-aligned visual grounding, action- and scene-flow supervision, and motion history improve policy performance and robustness.

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, Unitas is the first 3D-native world action model that aligns observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric frame, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands.

paragraphs.en: Video world–action modeling. Video-based policies use future prediction for control ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , with early WAMs coupling prediction and action learning through shared representations and generative objectives ( Li et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Cen et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) . Video-generation priors subsequently support joint video–action learning and future-conditioned policies ( Liao et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Bi et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , while heterogeneous robot and video-only data support cross-task and cross-embodiment transfer ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Efficient variants omit future generation at deployment or replace it with latent subgoals ( Yuan et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . These models primarily represent world evolution in images or visual latents. Reported sensitivity to viewpoint and robot initial-state changes ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Hong et al., 2026 ) highlights the importance of grounding perception, world evolution, and executable actions in a shared physical space.
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界–动作建模。 基于视频的策略利用未来预测进行控制（Hu et al., 2024），早期的WAM通过共享表示和生成目标将预测与动作学习耦合起来（Li et al., 2025b；Zhu et al., 2025；Cen et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2025a）。 随后，视频生成先验支持联合的视频–动作学习和未来条件策略（Liao et al., 2025；Shen et al., 2025；Bi et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a），而异构机器人数据和纯视频数据则支持跨任务和跨具身迁移（Ye et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a）。 高效的变体在部署时省略未来生成，或用潜在子目标替代（Yuan et al., 2026b；Chen et al., 2026a）。 这些模型主要用图像或视觉潜在变量来表示世界演化。 已报告的对视角和机器人初始状态变化的敏感性（Zhang et al., 2026b；Hong et al., 2026）凸显了将感知、世界演化和可执行动作锚定在共享物理空间中的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Policy learning in 3D space. Explicit 3D representations improve spatial understanding for manipulation ( Shridhar et al., 2023 ; Ze et al., 2024 ; Zhen et al., 2024 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) . Geometry-aware world models augment visual prediction with image-aligned geometric signals ( Zhen et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . In policy learning, LaMP ( Wang et al., 2026b ) and GeomVLA ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) use intermediate motion features from trajectory denoising to condition action generation. PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) follows the complementary direction, predicting scene flow conditioned on robot motion for planning. Unitas jointly models agent motion and its conditional scene response through point flows, while supporting direct command execution without generating scene flows.
paragraphs.zh: 三维空间中的策略学习。 显式的三维表示能够提升智能体对空间的理解，从而改善操控能力（Shridhar 等，2023；Ze 等，2024；Zhen 等，2024；Qu 等，2025）。 几何感知的世界模型通过引入与图像对齐的几何信号，增强了视觉预测能力（Zhen 等，2025；Guo 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026）。 在策略学习中，LaMP（Wang 等，2026b）和 GeomVLA（Xiong 等，2026）利用轨迹去噪过程中获得的中间运动特征来约束动作生成。 PointWorld（Huang 等，2026）则采取了互补的方向：通过基于机器人运动的场景流预测来进行规划。 Unitas 通过点流联合建模智能体的运动及其条件化的场景响应，同时支持直接执行命令而无需生成场景流。

paragraphs.en: For robots, we sample N g = 20 N_{g}=20 points from the URDF-defined gripper geometry of each arm and retain their link-local coordinates. Forward kinematics maps these points into the world frame at each recorded joint configuration, preserving correspondence through arm and finger motion. Human demonstrations use 21 MANO-derived keypoints ( Romero et al., 2017 ) per observed hand. Following PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , we mask robot pixels using the URDF and current joint state, back-project the remaining RGB-D pixels, and sample N s N_{s} scene query points. Simulator states supply ground-truth correspondences where available and scene-flow loss is applied only to valid trajectories. At inference, scene prediction requires current 3D query coordinates from depth or supplied geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 对于机器人，我们从每个机械臂的 URDF 定义的抓取器几何形状中采样 N g = 20 N_{g}=20 个点，并保留其连杆局部坐标。 正向运动学将这些点映射到每个记录的关节构型下的世界坐标系中，从而在机械臂和手指运动过程中保持点对应关系。 人类演示为每个观察到的手使用 21 个源自 MANO 的关键点（Romero 等人，2017）。 遵循 PointWorld（Huang 等人，2026）的方法，我们利用 URDF 和当前关节状态对机器人像素进行掩码处理，反向投影剩余的 RGB-D 像素，并采样 N s N_{s} 个场景查询点。 模拟器状态在可用时提供真实对应关系，并且仅对有效轨迹应用场景流损失。 在推理阶段，场景预测需要来自深度或所提供几何形状的当前 3D 查询坐标。

paragraphs.en: Coupled experts. Unitas uses a Mixture-of-Transformers ( Liang et al., 2024 ) with two diffusion transformers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) : a point dynamics expert for action and scene flows, and an action expert for the end-effector action chunk 𝐮 \mathbf{u} . The point dynamics expert processes spatially grounded primary-view VLM tokens, auxiliary-view features from the shared vision tower, and historical and future flow latents. At each layer, the smaller action expert reads the dynamics expert’s observation/language keys and values (KV), together with its own current-state and noisy command tokens. It predicts relative end-effector translation, rotation, and gripper openness at each future timestep.
paragraphs.zh: 耦合专家。 Unitas 使用一种混合 Transformer（Liang 等人，2024），其中包含两个扩散 Transformer（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）：一个用于动作和场景流的点动态专家，以及一个用于末端执行器动作片段 𝐮 \mathbf{u} 的动作专家。 点动态专家处理基于空间的主视角 VLM 标记、共享视觉塔提供的辅助视角特征，以及历史和未来的流潜在变量。 在每一层中，较小的动作专家会读取动态专家的观察/语言键值对（KV），同时结合自身的当前状态和带噪声的命令标记。 它在每个未来时间步预测末端执行器的相对平移、旋转和夹爪张开程度。

paragraphs.en: Our policy evaluation tests whether representing interaction in a shared metric space supports effective robot control. We examine task completion across simulation benchmarks, robustness when observations and initial states change, and execution on real-world robots.

paragraphs.en: Training settings. We initialize the vision-language backbone from Florence-2 ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) and randomly initialize all remaining components. We consider two training settings: (1) with pretraining , Unitas is pretrained on a mixture of real-robot, simulation, and human hand demonstrations, then fine-tuned on each downstream benchmark or dataset; (2) without pretraining , Unitas (w/o Pretrain) is fine-tuned directly on each target benchmark or dataset without the mixed-dataset pretraining stage. More detailed training configurations are provided in the appendix.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Unitas on single-arm and bimanual manipulation benchmarks. paragraphs.en: Mixed-dataset pretraining improves overall success by 2.6 percentage points, with the largest gains under robot initial-state changes from 84.8% to 94.2%, and language perturbations from 77.6% to 85.0%. paragraphs.en: Evaluation setup. We evaluate action-conditioned scene prediction on held-out RoboTwin rollouts using matched initial observations and robot-motion conditions, with simulator states providing ground-truth point trajectories. We compare against PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , which directly predicts 3D trajectories, and video-based Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2025 ) and X-WAM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Video predictions are lifted to 3D using SpatialTrackerV2 ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) , with Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) for Ctrl-World and native depth predictions for X-WAM. Both are calibrated using only initial-frame ground-truth depth. We report Moving ADE and FDE for trajectory and endpoint accuracy, Static ADE for background drift, and Moving Acc@1cm for the fraction of moving-point predictions within 1 cm of ground truth. Detailed evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix F.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 评估设置。 我们在预留的 RoboTwin 运行轨迹上，使用匹配的初始观测和机器人运动条件，对基于动作的场景预测进行评估，其中模拟器的状态提供了真实点轨迹数据。 我们将该方法与直接预测三维轨迹的 PointWorld（Huang 等，2026），以及基于视频的 Ctrl-World（Guo 等，2025）和 X-WAM（Guo 等，2026）进行了比较。 视频预测通过 SpatialTrackerV2（Xiao 等，2025）提升至三维空间，其中 Ctrl-World 使用 Depth Anything 3（Lin 等，2025），而 X-WAM 则使用原生深度预测。 两者均仅使用初始帧的真实深度数据进行校准。 我们报告了用于轨迹和终点准确性的 Moving ADE 与 FDE、用于背景漂移的 Static ADE，以及衡量移动点预测中在真实值 1 厘米范围内的比例的 Moving Acc@1cm。 详细的评估协议见附录 F.1。

paragraphs.en: Unitas advances a physical-space formulation of world action modeling: what the robot observes, how it moves, and how the scene responds are expressed within a common metric reference. Making interaction geometry an explicit prediction target connects world modeling with action learning and provides a shared representation across differing embodiments and observation views. The strong policy performance observed in simulation supports the value of this formulation for manipulation. More broadly, this work positions physical interaction as a unifying basis for embodied learning, with robot behavior and environmental change represented as complementary parts of the same process. Extending this foundation to reliable prediction over longer interactions and broader real-world deployment is a promising direction for general-purpose robot intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: Unitas 提出了一种物理空间形式的世界动作建模方法：机器人所观察到的内容、其移动方式以及场景的响应，都在一个共同的度量参考框架中得以表达。 将交互几何结构作为明确的预测目标，能够将世界建模与动作学习联系起来，并为不同形态的机器人和不同的观察视角提供共享的表示方式。 在模拟环境中观察到的强大策略性能，证明了这种建模方法在操控任务中的价值。 更广泛地说，这项工作将物理交互确立为具身学习的统一基础，其中机器人的行为与环境的变化被表示为同一过程中的互补部分。 将这一基础扩展到对更长时间交互的可靠预测，并实现更广泛的真实世界部署，是发展通用机器人智能的一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: We measure inference latency on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 D. As shown in Tab. 8 , Unitas directly produces executable actions without generating action or scene flows in 55.77 ms per chunk, providing a 2.20 × 2.20\times speedup over jointly generating actions and action flow. With only 1.7B parameters, this mode is 2.81 × 2.81\times faster than Fast-WAM without video generation and substantially faster than the joint video–action baselines Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) and Motus ( Bi et al., 2025 ) , supporting low-latency robot control. In world-model mode, the number of scene queries can be adjusted at inference to match the desired spatial sampling density and compute budget. Reducing scene queries from 3,000 to 1,024 lowers joint prediction latency from 561.60 ms to 305.49 ms, allowing a flexible trade-off between scene coverage and inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在单块 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 D 上测量推理延迟。 如表 8 所示，Unitas 无需生成动作或场景流，即可直接输出可执行动作，每段处理时间为 55.77 毫秒，相比同时生成动作和动作流的方式，速度提升了 2.20 × 2.20\times。 该模式仅包含 17 亿个参数，在没有视频生成的情况下比 Fast-WAM 快 2.81 × 2.81\times，也比联合视频–动作基线方法 Fast-WAM（Yuan et al., 2026b）和 Motus（Bi et al., 2025）快得多，支持低延迟的机器人控制。 在世界模型模式下，可以在推理时调整场景查询的数量，以匹配所需的空间采样密度和计算预算。 将场景查询数量从 3,000 减少到 1,024，可将联合预测延迟从 561.60 毫秒降低至 305.49 毫秒，从而在场景覆盖范围和推理成本之间实现灵活的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 4 evaluates 550 test clips from 50 RoboTwin tasks, with one Clean and ten Randomized episodes per task. Each episode contributes a fixed window near its midpoint, containing the current frame and 20 future recorded frames. Initial scene points are sampled with a 1.5 cm voxel grid. All methods share initial queries, point identities, ground-truth trajectories, and robot-motion conditions. For video methods, queries are projected into the initial image using camera calibration, accounting for resizing and cropping; only in-frame projections are tracked by SpatialTrackerV2. Ctrl-World uses Depth Anything 3 depth, whereas X-WAM uses its native depth predictions. Depth scale for Ctrl-World and inverse-depth affine calibration for X-WAM are estimated from initial observed depth and fixed throughout the video. Tracked trajectories are transformed into world coordinates, and their predicted displacements are anchored at the shared initial queries. No future ground-truth depth or trajectories are used for alignment.

paragraphs.en: In our evaluation, we label a point as moving when its maximum ground-truth displacement from its initial position over the 20 future frames exceeds 1 cm, and as static otherwise. These labels are fixed per clip and shared across methods. We score future frames 4 , 8 , 12 , 16 , 20 4,8,12,16,20 : ADE averages Euclidean errors over valid point–frame pairs in each group, Moving FDE measures moving-point error at frame 20, and Moving Acc@1cm is the fraction of valid moving-point–frame pairs with prediction error at most 1 cm. Metrics are first computed per clip, averaged within each task–condition group, and then averaged equally across groups. Clips without valid moving points are excluded only from the corresponding moving metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的评估中，当某一点在未来 20 帧内相对于其初始位置的最大真实位移超过 1 厘米时，我们将其标记为“移动点”，否则标记为“静态点”。 这些标签在每个剪辑中是固定的，并且所有方法共享相同的标签。 我们对第 4、8、12、16、20 帧进行评分：ADE 计算每组有效点-帧对的平均欧几里得误差；Moving FDE 衡量第 20 帧时移动点的误差；Moving Acc@1cm 则是有效移动点-帧对中预测误差不超过 1 厘米的比例。 各项指标首先按剪辑计算，然后在每个任务-条件组内取平均，最后再在各组之间等权平均。 没有有效移动点的剪辑仅从对应的移动点相关指标中排除。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three RoboTwin tasks, Adjust Bottle, Beat Block Hammer, and Blocks Ranking RGB, under Clean and Randomized conditions, yielding six settings. Each method is evaluated over 10 trials per setting, for 60 trials in total. We compare with X-WAM ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) , LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and Motus ( Bi et al., 2025 ) . Each generated action chunk is executed in the simulator, and the resulting observation conditions the next prediction. Models retain their native prediction horizons and are scored at completed action boundaries until termination. Fast-WAM executes all 32 actions rather than replanning after 24.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在“干净”和“随机化”两种条件下，对三个 RoboTwin 任务——调整瓶子、敲击积木锤和积木排序 RGB——进行评估，共得到六种设置。 每种方法在每种设置下均经过 10 次试验评估，总计 60 次试验。 我们与 X-WAM（Guo 等人，2026）、Fast-WAM（Yuan 等人，2026b）、LingBot-VA（Li 等人，2026）和 Motus（Bi 等人，2025）进行了比较。 每个生成的动作片段都在模拟器中执行，其产生的观察结果将作为下一次预测的条件。 模型保留其固有的预测范围，并在动作完成时进行评分，直至任务终止。 Fast-WAM 会执行全部 32 个动作，而不是在 24 个动作后重新规划。

paragraphs.en: For Unitas , the point dynamics expert generates an action flow, while the action expert separately generates an executable command chunk from the same observation and instruction. The dynamics expert then predicts scene-flow trajectories conditioned on its generated action flow. We compare these predictions with the ground-truth scene trajectories resulting from executing the action expert’s command chunk in the simulator.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Unitas，点动态专家会生成一个动作流，而动作专家则基于相同的观察和指令，单独生成一个可执行的命令片段。 随后，动态专家会根据其生成的动作流预测场景流的轨迹。 我们将这些预测结果与在模拟器中执行动作专家命令片段后得到的真实场景轨迹进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Ground-truth query points follow their simulator objects or links. SpatialTrackerV2 lifts video predictions using X-WAM’s native depth or Depth Anything 3 estimates for RGB-only models, with initial-frame depth calibration and query anchoring. We apply the 1 cm displacement threshold to label moving points within each scored chunk. Metrics are averaged within rounds, then within episodes, across trials within each setting, and finally equally across the six settings. Rounds without valid moving points are excluded only from moving-point metrics; all episodes are retained regardless of task outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 真实查询点跟随其模拟器对象或链接。 SpatialTrackerV2 利用 X-WAM 的原生深度数据，或针对仅 RGB 模型使用的 Depth Anything 3 估计值来提升视频预测结果，并包含初始帧的深度校准与查询锚定。 我们对每个评分片段内的移动点应用 1 厘米的位移阈值进行标注。 各项指标先在各轮次内取平均，再在各回合内取平均，接着跨各设置下的试验取平均，最后对六个设置进行等权重平均。 没有有效移动点的轮次仅被排除在移动点相关指标之外；所有回合无论任务结果如何均予以保留。

paragraphs.en: Fig. G.2 shows predictions on DROID and RH20T conditioned on ground-truth gripper trajectories. Despite receiving scene-flow supervision only from simulation, Unitas captures action-conditioned scene changes in real environments outside this supervision distribution. These qualitative results suggest that the learned interaction dynamics can transfer from simulation to real scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 图 G.2 展示了在真实抓夹轨迹条件下，对 DROID 和 RH20T 的预测结果。 尽管场景流监督仅来自模拟环境，Unitas 仍能在该监督分布之外的真实环境中捕捉到基于动作的场景变化。 这些定性结果表明，所学习到的交互动态能够从模拟环境迁移到真实场景。
